text:
leo.p: hi all — I accepted the org invite but get a 403 when trying to access private repos (e.g., redwood/platform). The UI says 'You don’t have permission to view this repository'. Anyone know if team membership is delayed?
nina-peopleops: welcome, leo! tagging IT to check invite state: @it-support-bot. Also which email did you accept with?
leo.p: accepted with leo.p@redwood.ai. I can see my profile in the org but not any teams.
it-support-bot: Checking GitHub org state. Quick check: are you seeing your SSO status under Settings > Organizations (it should show "Provisioned by <IdP>")?
leo.p: under Organizations it shows redwood (SSO pending) and a note "SSO not yet approved".
it-support-bot: That explains the 403. Our org requires SSO to be approved on an account before team membership sync. It looks like the IdP (Okta) didn't mark you as provisioned because of a group sync issue. @nina-peopleops can you confirm Leo is in the right Okta group?
nina-peopleops: Leo, can you confirm your Okta email matches your GitHub work email (leo.p@redwood.ai) and that you accepted the Okta invite? Sometimes people miss the Okta enrollment email.
leo.p: I did accept Okta, and profile shows me as in team: Engineering > Platform (but maybe the Okta group name is platform-engineering-prod?).
it-support-bot: Found the problem: the Okta group name in the provisioning app is "platform-engineering" but the SCIM mapping was pointed at "platform-engineering-prod". I'll push a manual SCIM sync now and approve SSO for your account. This will trigger team membership to appear within a minute or two.
devex-omar: FYI for anyone hitting this: `gh orgs sync --confirm` won't help here because SCIM is handled by Okta for us. Reach out to IT/PeopleOps when you see SSO pending.
it-support-bot: Manual SCIM sync initiated at 2026-04-01T10:48:30Z. Approving SSO post-sync.
leo.p: I can see frontend-team and platform now (woo!). Trying to open the repo now.
ellis-eng: Heads up — if you still see 403 after teams show up, try logging out and back in or run `gh auth refresh -h github.com` to refresh tokens used by gh or VSCode. Saved me earlier.
leo.p: Refreshed and can clone `git@github.com:redwood/platform.git` now. Thanks! One last question: how do I get write access to a repo for my first PR?
nina-peopleops: Open a request in infra/repo-access and tag @ellis-eng + @it-support-bot, or you can ask your team lead to bump your role to write in the team settings. We typically grant write after a brief review.
leo.p: filed infra/repo-access request, tagged @ellis-eng. Thanks everyone :tada:
ellis-eng: Approved your write access for redwood/platform (added to team with write) — you should see it shortly. Welcome aboard!
leo.p: Confirmed I can push to my branch. Super smooth onboarding, thanks :smile:
